# Heading-echo material-redundancy controls

The controls of root decision omp-plugins-q4bb.10, as heading and first-unit pairs. The
first three are the rule's own bad examples and satisfy the predicate, so the host still
admits them. The last four are measured false positives on plain section titles: three fail
the lexical-echo clause and the fourth adds a figure the heading does not carry.
